title.narrative: Support to Rural Electrification Programme

description.narrative: The specific objective of the action is to improve access to reliable electricity in rural areas through the extension of the national grid.The action will contribute to the implementation of rural electrification programme of the Government of Tanzania and REA with a focus on the Turnkey III program for rural electrification 2016-2020 targeting settlements which are within 10 km of the 33-kV MV network which exist at the end of 2015.
